allocation.implementationObservation: The close-candidate set is computed after the initial stage and frozen in the resumable checkpoint; selected candidates are extended to the maximum without reevaluating or pruning the set between extension stages.

confidence.interpretation: A post-hoc per-candidate 95% Hoeffding radius is larger than half the top-two mean difference, so their intervals overlap. The collector's high-confidence eligibility remains deliberately disabled; this run is not a usable policy label or strategy result.

nextResearchGate: Implement staged confidence reevaluation and candidate pruning with checkpoint/resume identity coverage, then compare rollout cost and retained top-plan ordering on frozen development positions before scaling label collection. Keep high-confidence policy eligibility disabled until an independently validated criterion exists.
